title: Flowerage
label: Drag City
pull_quote: progressive tactics with earworm hooks & phased/fuzzed guitars
notes: Chicago trio (Brett Sova, Jeremy Freeze, Josh Johannpeter). Lead single 'Blow Up' (Aug. 2026, post-punk-leaning opener); second single 'Fever Days' shared with visualizer and tour dates. Exact 'Fever Days' date not confirmed.

title: Live at Pageant: Soloveev
label: Sea Note (listed on Drag City site)
notes: One-sided LP, 23-minute improvised taishogoto + guitar set recorded on iPhone, May 10, 2025, Philadelphia. Mike Polizze is ex-Purling Hiss. Label listed as Sea Note on Bandcamp; appears in Drag City's announcements. Experimental; niche fit.

title: Quiet Days in Cliché
label: Drag City
pull_quote: acoustic improvisations that draw threads through space, looking for what more could happen
notes: Red Krayola founder's first-ever solo guitar album and first solo album in 56 years; recorded on a smartphone. Instrumental.

title: Ghosts of American Psychonauts
label: No Quarter
source_name: The Line of Best Fit / KLOF Mag
notes: Eight-song live set recorded at The Pico Union Project, Los Angeles, Valentine's Day weekend 2025. His 2026 studio LP 'We Are Together Again' was Domino/No Quarter. Found while checking Drag City top artist Matt Sweeney & Bonnie Prince Billy.

title: MO LÉAN (remastered)
label: Domino
notes: Fermanagh-born, Dublin-based artist newly signed to Domino; global release of remastered 2024 album, digital adds new track 'PORT NA H-EALA'. Irish trad plus 'ancestral electronic music'; not rock but a possible left-field pick.
